description: Source code for a web scraper class 'VeroniqueCloutier' that extracts recipe information from veroniquecloutier.com, including author, title, yields, ingredients, ingredient groups, instructions, and description.

classes.name: VeroniqueCloutier
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from veroniquecloutier.com

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the website

methods.name: author
methods.description: Extracts the author's name from the recipe page

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Raises exception indicating total time is not provided by the website

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Determines the number of servings from the page content, handling French numerals

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts a list of ingredients from the recipe page

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Extracts ingredients grouped by purpose or returns a flat list if no groups

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts cooking instructions as a text block

methods.name: description
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the recipe description
